notes.title: Online multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hi, 

Due to lack of use, the servers for online multiplare will be shut down today. It just doesn't make sense to keep paying for them when they are not used.  Local play with bots will still be enabled, and if anyone wants to run a local server, please write a reply here or contact me and I'll give you access to the code. 

If you want a refund of the game because of this, I will of course grant this.

Apologies for any inconvenience!
/Joel
